items.title: Paul Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: Pat Boone as having a band that has Frank Capp, Barney Kessel and Ray Brown and me for a rhythm section.

ctx.x: Yes. You’ve had a relationship with Steve Allen too, ongoing?

Yes. Steve Allen inherited me. We had a show at NBC back in I guess about 1965 I guess it was, with Pat Boone, who I had also worked with. And Pat had a five day a week show at NBC and he was signed up for 13 weeks and I came in with the band. Well you don’t think of Pat Boone as having a band that has Frank Capp, Barney Kessel and Ray Brown and me for a rhythm section. Plus some very good players. And it was only about a ten- piece band. But at the end of the 13 weeks they decided to let Pat go and they put…
Do you guys do two pianos?
